description: This file provides high-level functions for interacting with DataFlash memory devices on an Atmel microcontroller platform. It includes initialization, printing device info, selecting a device based on address, and read/write/erase operations.

classes.name: AT91S_DATAFLASH_INFO
classes.description: Structure holding info about each DataFlash device, including pages, size, offsets, and ID.

classes.name: AT91S_DataFlash
classes.description: Main data structure representing a DataFlash device, including its descriptor, device parameters, and related info.

methods.name: int AT91F_DataflashInit(void)
methods.description: Initializes DataFlash devices, probing their type and configuring parameters accordingly.

methods.name: void AT91F_DataflashPrintInfo(void)
methods.description: Prints information about recognized DataFlash devices.

methods.name: AT91PS_DataFlash AT91F_DataflashSelect(AT91PS_DataFlash pFlash,unsigned int * addr)
methods.description: Selects a specific DataFlash device based on the provided address.

methods.name: int read_dataflash(unsigned long addr,unsigned long size,char * result)
methods.description: Reads data from DataFlash memory at a specified address and size.

methods.name: int write_dataflash(unsigned long addr_dest,unsigned int addr_src,unsigned int size)
methods.description: Writes data to DataFlash memory at a specified address.

methods.name: int erase_dataflash(unsigned long addr_dest)
methods.description: Erases a DataFlash device at a specified address.

ctags.name: read_dataflash
ctags.pattern: /^int read_dataflash(unsigned long addr, unsigned long size, char *result)$/

ctags.name: write_dataflash
ctags.pattern: /^int write_dataflash(unsigned long addr_dest, unsigned int addr_src,$/
ctags.signature: (unsigned long addr_dest,unsigned int addr_src,unsigned int size)
